subject.title: Feature discussion: model-centric token / cost view across providers

question: Should CodexBar sponsor a dedicated cross-provider Models view now, limit initial work to provider-scoped top-model display, or defer model-centric aggregation?
rationale: VISION.md requires feature sign-off, and the choice establishes new model-identity, cost, duplicate-accounting, settings, CLI, and UI contracts that source inspection cannot resolve safely.

options.title: Design the aggregation contract
options.body: Approve a dedicated Models view only after canonical identity, provenance, currency, and duplicate-accounting rules are written and tested against representative providers.

options.title: Ship provider-scoped Top Models
options.body: Allow a narrow display-only feature that surfaces existing breakdowns without claiming cross-provider identity or combined costs.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep provider-centric reports as the supported product boundary until a stronger user need or external canonical-model standard emerges.

recommendation.title: Design the aggregation contract
recommendation.body: Approve a dedicated Models view only after canonical identity, provenance, currency, and duplicate-accounting rules are written and tested against representative providers.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner recently implemented the relevant model-history UI and VISION.md reserves new-feature scope for explicit sign-off.
